create.name: Mark Matousek
create.bio:
Mark Matousek is an American author and teacher who uses writing as a form of spiritual inquiry. Born in Los Angeles and educated at Berkeley, UCLA and Oxford, he began his career in New York journalism, rising to senior editor at Andy Warhol's Interview, before leaving publishing in the mid-1980s to travel and seek through Europe, India and the United States. He later turned to psychology, philosophy and spirituality, assisted Sogyal Rinpoche with The Tibetan Book of Living and Dying, co-wrote Dialogues with a Modern Mystic with Andrew Harvey, and helped edit Ram Dass's Still Here.

His own books include the memoirs Sex Death Enlightenment and The Boy He Left Behind, along with Ethical Wisdom, When You're Falling, Dive, Writing to Awaken and a study of Emerson as a guide to living. His teaching method, also called Writing to Awaken, invites people to tell the truth about their lives on the page as a way of loosening old stories and finding out who they are now; it is meant for non-writers as much as authors. He teaches it through retreats and workshops in North America and Europe, live online classes, self-paced courses, an online membership community and one-to-one mentoring, and he founded The Seekers Forum for open spiritual conversation.

courses.title: Writing as a Spiritual Practice
courses.description: A self-paced course that uses guided writing prompts and short teachings to turn the page into a place of contemplation. It follows his Writing to Awaken method.

courses.title: A Whole New Life
courses.description: A six-week self-study course from his Writing to Awaken series, aimed at opening a fresh chapter of life. Writing prompts help you look at what you want to change and what matters most.

courses.title: The Engine of Desire
courses.description: A self-study writing course that looks honestly at desire, what drives us and what we really want. Exercises help you turn that insight into a more original way of living.

courses.title: Waking Up with Emerson: Guided Writing Series
courses.description: A six-session recorded series reading Ralph Waldo Emerson on self-trust and nonconformity, paired with writing practice. It draws on his book about Emerson as a teacher for daily life.

courses.title: Private Sessions with Mark
courses.description: One-to-one mentoring on Zoom, from creative and personal development to feedback on a manuscript. Sessions are arranged by email.
